related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

request.operation: read the committed implementation through the normal selected-session first-use context interface

outcome.interpretation_limit: This is a current read of the selected session's stored binding snapshot, not a fresh provider probe. Substrate availability does not establish semantic test correctness. The evidence identifies one session's unselected compiler-checkout dependency and makes no claim about the active compiler campaign.

pressure_hypothesis.title: First-use context reports unavailable capability counts without exposing a bounded actionable cause
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment selected-session context and capability bindings
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose a bounded binding-level availability summary in first-use context with stable resolution identifiers, while keeping unknown bindings distinct and omitting free-text reasons and filesystem paths.

not_measured: Whether another agent can act more quickly or avoid the separate inspection as a result of this presentation.
Whether an environment revalidation would resolve or preserve the stored unavailable state.
Recurrence across sessions and the effect on service reliability.
